criteria.name: archetype_and_method
criteria.criterion: Archetype named and primary method justified
criteria.detail: PASS: Names the archetype explicitly (software_saas, enterprise SaaS with high margins/asset-light/recurring revenue) and justifies DCF as primary method based on those characteristics ("this is not a bank, REIT, or insurer where DCF is a poor fit"), satisfying both (a) and (b).

criteria.name: unresolved_risk
criteria.criterion: ≥1 risk left explicitly unresolved (no self-neutralizing close)
criteria.detail: PASS: Multiple risks are left explicitly unresolved — e.g., the net debt vintage gap ($7.11B vs $30.34B) is flagged as "a real, material gap...should be treated as a known limitation," the durability of the 15.8% FCF growth assumption is repeatedly questioned without resolution, and the missing peer comps data is stated as "a genuine data gap" — none of these are neutralized with reassurances.
